name: @piex-dev/hashline
description: Hashline patch language extension for pi — compact, line-anchored, tag-verified file edits
author: debugtalk

scripts.postinstall: if [ -d node_modules/@oh-my-pi/hashline ]; then node -e "require('patch-package')"; else mkdir -p ../../../patches && cp patches/* ../../../patches/ && cd ../../.. && node -e "require(require.resolve('patch-package',{paths:['node_modules/@piex-dev/hashline/node_modules','node_modules']}))" && rm -f patches/@oh-my-pi+hashline+17.1.3.patch patches/@oh-my-pi+pi-natives+17.1.3.patch; fi
